materials_exhausted.notes: XML/PDF/OA package, Methods S1 doc, CD/NMR supplementary docs, supplement/image inventory, and linked database snapshots were checked. Remaining caveats are adjudicated scientific/database conflicts, not open material gaps.

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: DBAASP row-level MIC and toxicity rows were reconciled to XML/source text where supported; spelling, aggregation, and database-only/later-claim conflicts are preserved as source_conflict rather than promoted to clean verification.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Tables 1 and 2 are MIC matrices, Tables 3 and 4 are CFU killing-kinetics matrices, and hemolysis/cytotoxicity are negative text-supported rows; no database-only activity was treated as a primary row.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Mechanism output is limited to structural context, phenotypic killing kinetics, and inferred membrane-context caveats; direct mechanism overclaims were removed.
per_layer_decision_rationale.worker_6_gate: The prior full_source_review_not_completed ticket is closed because owner-layer artifacts now contain source-reviewed repairs and no open rework target remains.

caution_findings.evidence_context: 42 linked database audit rows remain source_conflict because they contain spelling/taxonomy variants, ND-to-inactive transformations, or APD6/dbAMP/DRAMP aggregation not wholly supported by this local primary paper.
Table 2 MIC values are preserved with unit_not_reported_in_table_header rather than inventing a unit from neighboring tables.
CD/NMR and killing kinetics support structure/phenotype context, but no direct molecular target or membrane-disruption assay is present in local materials.

adjudication_summary: Source-reviewed repair completed for cathelicidin-BF paper: Table 3/4 CFU kinetics and toxicity rows are now locator-backed, database conflicts are preserved with source-review context, and final acceptance is with explicit cautions rather than clean conflict erasure.
